newsitem.title: USA: Bristol declares two-for-one split, ups div.
newsitem.headline: Bristol declares two-for-one split, ups div.

text.p: Bristol-Myers Squibb Co said on Tuesday its board of directors declared a two-for-one stock split in the form of a stock dividend payable on or about February 28 to shareholders of record on February 7.
The company also said it raised its quarterly dividend by $0.01 on a pre-split basis to $0.76 per share.
The dividend would be payable on February 1 to shareholders of record on January 3 on a pre-split basis, Bristol said.
There would be about 1,080 million common shares outstanding after the split, the company said.

"These actions demonstrate our confidence in the future outlook for our global businesses as well as our commitment to maximize shareholder value," Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Charles Heimbold Jr said.
